basic_details.job_title: MCD Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 35 Senior Resident and Junior Resident Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), Senior Resident (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), Senior Resident (Paediatrics) and 5 more, including Junior Resident
basic_details.short_information: Update: A corrigendum dated 21 November 2026 adds 7 Junior Resident (MBBS) posts (UR-06, ST-01) to the same walk-in interview on 3 December 2026, so the total is now 35 posts (28 Senior Resident and 7 Junior Resident). The Senior Resident posts and the walk-in date, time and venue are unchanged.

how_to_apply: Download the application proforma from https://mcdonline.nic.in/ (Recruitment tab) or use the form printed in the notice.
Fill all columns in bold, clear, legible letters, preferably typed.
Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of documents in the order listed.
Bring a Bank Draft/Pay order in favour of COMMISSIONER, MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF DELHI, payable at Delhi, unless exempted.
Report with originals for registration and verification between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 03/12/2026.
important_instructions: Reserved category (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) PG candidates may walk in every Thursday before 03.12.2026, on 03.12.2026 and every Thursday thereafter till vacancies are filled Unfilled vacancies: applications in prescribed proforma accepted at weekly Thursday walk-in until filled by PG Senior Residents Applications in any mode other than the prescribed proforma at the walk-in will be rejected Number of posts may increase or decrease including complete withdrawal No TA/DA for appearing in the interview No private practice allowed

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay Matrix level-11 plus usual allowances. Purely contractual, one year initially, extendable by one year at a time up to 3 years (for PG candidates only) Junior Residents: six (06) months initially, extendable by another six (06) months up to a maximum of one (01) year, subject to satisfactory work performance and conduct Total tenure of senior residency normally not over 3 years including other Govt. hospitals; up to 5 years in the separate list case Can be terminated by either side on giving 15 days salary without assigning any reason No claim or right for regular appointment Non-PG appointee will be replaced if a suitable PG candidate is later selected Governed by Residency Scheme of Govt. of India, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

content_sections.heading: How Will MCD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Registration and physical verification of original documents Walk-in Interview Marks: qualification (PG Degree 20 / PG Diploma 17 / Non-PG with 2 years 14) plus interview 05, total 25 Qualification marks: P.G. Degree 20, P.G. Diploma 17, Non P.G. with 2 years (1 year in same specialty) 14 Performance in Interview: 05 marks; total 25 marks Candidates with 3 completed years of senior residency go on a separate list considered after fresh candidates

content_sections.text: Filled-up application form and 01 passport size photograph Original certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), age proof (10th certificate), address proof and identity proof Registration certificate of MCI of State/Central/DMC and valid DMC Registration Medical fitness certificate from Govt. Medical Officer All MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/Diploma mark sheets (year wise) and Degree/Diploma certificate Experience certificates and any publication, if any

Bring a Bank Draft/Pay order in favour of COMMISSIONER, MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF DELHI, payable at Delhi, unless exempted. Report with originals for registration and verification between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 03/12/2026.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 35 vacancies (28 Senior Resident and 7 Junior Resident): 2 Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), 7 Senior Resident (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), 7 Senior Resident (Paediatrics), 5 Senior Resident (Emergency Medicine), 4 Senior Resident (Medicine), 2 Senior Resident (Surgery), 1 Senior Resident (Radiology) and 7 Junior Resident (MBBS) posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mata Gujri Hospital, Administration Department, Block-11, Near Tilak Nagar Metro Station, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General (Unreserved)/OBC/EWS: Rs. 1000. SC/ST: Rs. 500. PwD: Exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on last day of submission of Application). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: For SR-Pay Matrix level-11 + usual allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Anaesthesia), For SR-Pay Matrix level-11 + usual allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), For SR-Pay Matrix level-11 + usual allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Paediatrics), For SR-Pay Matrix level-11 + usual allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Emergency Medicine), For SR-Pay Matrix level-11 + usual allowances as admissible for Senior Resident (Medicine).

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institution plus PG degree/DNB/Diploma/MDS (for Dental) or equivalent in the concerned specialty. If adequate candidates are not available, MBBS with at least 2 years' experience in a recognized 100-bedded hospital (1 year in the concerned specialty) can be considered. 27 posts are for PG candidates only; 1 UR post in Paediatrics is open to PG and Non-PG candidates. The 7 Junior Resident posts are for MBBS candidates as per the Recruitment Rules for Junior Residents. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q9. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration with Delhi Medical Council (valid DMC registration) required. EWS candidates must submit family income certificate before the interview. OBC certificate must be issued by competent authority of Govt. of India. Qualification and experience counted up to the date of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Non-PG candidates for the 27 replacement vacancies, which are for PG candidates only. In-service candidates without a No Objection Certificate.
